Loblolly Fest 2026
October 17, 2026 | The Bluff Amphitheater | Gadsden, Alabama

We’re kicking off something special right here in Gadsden.

Loblolly Fest is coming to The Bluff Amphitheater on October 17th for its very first year, bringing a full day of live music, good food, cold drinks, and a whole lot of fun to our hometown.

Born and raised right here in Hokes Bluff, Drake White is bringing this festival home. We wanted to create a day that feels like Gadsden and Hokes Bluff. Good people, good music, and everybody coming together for a great cause.

And that’s what makes Loblolly Fest even more special. A portion of proceeds from the festival will benefit Drake White’s Benefit for the Brain, supporting a cause that means a whole lot to Drake and his family.

So grab your friends, and come spend the day with us at The Bluff. We’re starting something new, and we’d love for y’all to be there from the very beginning.

One day. One hometown. One hell of a good time.

This is a General Admission Only show. Seating is available on a first-come, first-served basis, but cannot be reserved or guaranteed. Seating is located behind the standing-room-only section at the front of the stage. Come early to claim your spot and enjoy the show! All sales are final. No refunds.

Festival Policies:
Outdoor Show: Rain or shine. This outdoor show will proceed regardless of weather

Clear Bag Policy: Only clear bags are allowed inside the venue.

Re-entry: Re-entry is permitted. All guests must go through security screening each time they re-enter the festival.

Security Measures: Weapons of any kind (this includes pocketknives) will not be permitted.

Lawn Chairs: Feel free to bring your own lawn or stadium chairs, but remove them from the bag when coming through security.

Food and Beverages: No outside food or beverages are allowed.

Photography: No professional photography equipment is allowed inside the venue without prior approval from management. For approval media requests please contact [email protected]

No Pets: Please leave your furry friends at home

Tickets that are scalped or resold through third party sites are not eligible for refunds or purchaser protection and are subject to cancellation without refund.

Support and Times Subject to Change. The venue & promoter are not responsible for accidents. Follow us on Facebook & Instagram for updates

All prices listed include all required ticketing fees. Taxes, shipping, and other applicable charges may apply at checkout.
